instagram.caption:
Are writers cooked?

Microsoft ranked 785 jobs by how much their work overlaps with AI. Six writing jobs made the top 20: writers and authors (#3), reporters (#11), technical writers (#13), proofreaders (#15), editors (#16) and PR specialists (#18).

But the researchers who made the list warn against reading it as job loss: “This would be a mistake.”

US job projections, 2025 to 2035: technical writers +1%, writers and authors little or no change, editors −1%, reporters −6% (the average job: +3%). And about 11,900 openings for writers and authors every year, mostly as people retire or move to other work.

Our read: heating up, not cooked. Tasks change before titles do. The first draft got cheap, so own a subject, not just the words, get good at editing AI drafts, and test a direction next to yours.
